en.hubeali:
Mansour, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘I<sup>asws</sup> heard my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
Completion of the Quran is up to where you know’’.
en.sarwar: 7. Mansur has narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘The Messenger of Allah has said, “Complete
reading of the Holy Quran is reading to the extent that you know.’”
